title: Deep House
tagline: Soulful drums, patient grooves and a warm low-end glow.
summary: Deep house centers on slow-burn rhythm and warm, layered textures rather than spectacle. It often carries the feel of a club after midnight: subtle percussion, warm synth pads and enough space for the groove to breathe. The style is as much atmosphere as it is movement.

pillars.name: Frankie Knuckles
pillars.why: Frankie Knuckles helped define the style’s warm, soulful direction and its role in the club.

pillars.name: Kerri Chandler
pillars.why: Kerri Chandler made deep house feel more intimate and rhythmically rich without losing its grounding.

pillars.name: Masters At Work
pillars.why: Masters At Work gave the form a more rhythmic and melodic edge while keeping its club focus.
